description: This dashboard turns the grading system on our own work. It grades the coding-agent sessions that built this repo using the same pass/fail rules we apply to the simulated decisions elsewhere in the project. A ticket counts as shipped correctly only if its pull request passed review and the full test suite. Cost is shown only where it can be tied to one specific session with certainty; where an older ticket's cost cannot be separated from other work done at the same time, we leave it blank rather than guess. Scope, stated plainly: this reflects one developer's build sessions, not the whole team's.
title: Gradebook Meta: Grading Our Own Build Sessions

widgets.description: Two honest numbers rather than one blended average: how many of our own build tickets shipped correctly, and how much of that work has a cost figure we can trace with certainty. They sit side by side on purpose. Older tickets are correctly counted as shipped, but their cost cannot be separated from other work running at the same time, so no number is invented for them.

filter.expression: augmentloop.decision.type = 'build_session' AND gen_ai.evaluation.score.label = 'correct' AND augmentloop.grade.source IN ('math','reality')
augmentloop.decision.type = 'build_session' AND gen_ai.evaluation.score.label = 'correct' AND augmentloop.grade.source IN ('math','reality')
